name: Andorhal inspection office, mage quarter and the sample room (offstage in chapter 7)
region: Andorhal, across the city from the militia post; the mage quarter with a Kirin Tor house

sensoryProfile.sight: Not on page. Described only by report: shelves of sealed, marked sample bags; a copy room; a door that opens to a magister's ring. 'Behind a door that opened to a magister's ring.'
sensoryProfile.atmosphere: Not shown. Sylvanas imagines herself as a bow in a corridor with everyone turning to look at her.

establishedFacts.fact: The inspection office keeps the second copy of every bill that leaves the city under a yard's mark, and takes a bag from every flagged load for the sample room: sealed, marked with the bill, kept on shelves; 'nobody opens them'.
The sample room needs a magister's ring; Corin has the tags and can get Jaina in. The copy room has its own key; the sample room has its own, 'because the magisters wanted—'.
Jaina reads every shelf there; Corin writes her results (Heavy/Clean) against bill numbers and drawn yard marks.
A Kirin Tor house in the mage quarter is Jaina's stated destination at the gate. Corin's letters went to the Citadel inspection desk and the Archmage's secretary in Dalaran.

eventsHere.event: Jaina's read of all the sample-room shelves (offstage): every bag on a copied mark heavy, every bag on a true mark clean.
